name: University of the Punjab (PU), Lahore
_note: Basic criteria (Matric/4 + FA/FSc + additional marks over Matric total/4 + FA/FSc total) and closing figures from 'Undergraduate Programs Merit of Last Year 2025' (Directorate of Students Affairs, pu.edu.pk). Test-based formula (75% academic + 25% entry test) from PU's official basic merit calculator. Records: BS 1st semester and BS 5th semester, morning and evening/replica/self-support columns as printed; figures given in marks, 'Nil', 'new program', ambiguous cells and gender-split Sheikh Zayed figures are not stored. Hafiz-e-Quran +20 from the Admission Regulations Book (p. 23). 2024 and 2023: 'Undergraduate Programs Merit of Last Year 2024' and '... 2023' (same office; removed from pu.edu.pk, read from Wayback copies of 5 Jun 2025 and 26 Sep 2024). BS 1st-semester figures only (177 and 164 records), read by word position on 1 Nov 2026 and mapped to the 2025 program names; skipped: marks-based, 'to be updated', gender-split, unlabelled or column-ambiguous cells (e.g. Mathematics, Social Work 2024, International Relations, B.Ed. Elementary 2024, Urdu 2023), and 5th-semester columns. 2023 'Education Elementary/Secondary/...' rows are stored as 'BS Education (...)' because the file lists them under BS columns. PUCIT 2023 prints no campus (stored as Lahore).

formulas.label: BS 1st semester, basic criteria (no entry test)
formulas.source_note: Merit of Last Year 2025, p. 1, 'Basic Criteria for BS (4-Yrs) Program': marks earned (1/4 of Matric + FA/FSc + additional marks) / total marks (1/4 of Matric + FA/FSc). With 1100 + 1100 totals Matric counts 20% and FSc 80%. Additional marks (Admission Regulations Book, p. 23): Hafiz-e-Quran = 20, added to marks earned.

formulas.label: BS 1st semester with an entry test (75% academic + 25% test)
formulas.source_note: PU Basic Criteria Merit Calculator, 1st semester BS (4-Yrs): ((Matric/4 + Inter + additional) / (Matric total/4 + Inter total)) x 75 + (test obtained / test total) x 25.

parts.label: FA / FSc / ICS / I.Com
parts.hint: Full marks, inside the 75% academic share

parts.hint: Weight 25%; type your marks and the test total
